purpose: Make deep person-specific astrology analysis coverage-driven rather than salience-driven, so important rule families cannot be silently overlooked.
governing_principles: Coverage before salience: a striking aspect never waives the remaining passes.
Use source-native rules before modern synthesis.
Separate date-stable planets from birth-time-sensitive angles/houses.
Preserve contradictions and nulls; do not average them away.
Do not count the same astronomy multiple times merely because several traditions describe it.
State detection, endpoint classification, and exact-day localization are separate timing tasks.
Every required pass receives APPLIED, NOT_APPLICABLE, UNAVAILABLE, or SUPERSEDED before synthesis.

required_passes.title: Information firewall / evidence class
checks: classify analysis as clean-room, retrospective-blind, development, or prospective
for a new clean-room person, freeze first-pass predictions before opening biography/survey/history
record exactly which outcome data were visible before each model change

required_passes.title: Birth-time and location sensitivity
checks: recompute ASC/MC and house-sensitive claims across declared birth-time uncertainty
distinguish date-stable planets/aspects from time-sensitive angles/houses
downgrade or set-valued report any claim that changes materially across uncertainty
if documentary time uncertainty is unknown, label angular/house conclusions conditional

required_passes.title: Astronomy provenance
checks: tropical and Lahiri sidereal states when tradition requires
ASC/MC and tradition-specific houses when time supports them

required_passes.title: Complete chart inventory
checks: Uranus Neptune Pluto as modern/timing context
house positions in each active tradition

required_passes.title: Aspect and angular geometry
checks: all major planet-planet aspects under frozen orb policy
do not omit hard aspects because interpretation is inconvenient
emit a complete aspect ledger, not only interpreted aspects
apply one frozen orb policy per aspect family and record near-boundary cases

required_passes.title: Lilly source-native strength/debility
checks: bounded native totals plus component ledger

required_passes.title: Phaladeepika/Jyotish testimonies
checks: kendra/trikona/upachaya/dusthana where current source module supports
do not invent dashas/vargas/yogas absent a frozen implementation

required_passes.title: House-ruler topology
checks: rulers of all 12 houses under each active tradition
topic-specific derived houses only with declared source rule
dispositor/rulership chains under the active tradition
reception only when a frozen source-native implementation exists; otherwise mark unavailable

required_passes.title: Behavior/domain mapping
checks: run full V1.4 source-grounded rule vector
run target-blind domain map where allowed
record positive negative and null domains
six-rule owner-fitted fingerprint only as secondary comparator

required_passes.title: Contradiction and dependency audit
checks: positive and negative testimonies for same planet/domain
sect vs dignity vs house contradictions
label unresolved rather than force one narrative

required_passes.title: Question-specific significator pass
checks: run every retained endpoint-specific module applicable from merged timing registry
do not use relationship/father/spiritual modules outside scope without justification

required_passes.title: Fast trigger and day localization
checks: fast transits including Moon/Venus/Mars only under a predeclared trigger rule
run generic daily timing candidate when applicable
separate fast trigger from slower state qualification
scan false-positive burden over declared control horizon

required_passes.title: Retained experimental candidates
checks: CF-003 when its behavioral-target prerequisites exist
relationship V3 when relationship timing is asked
father-loss V4 only for sudden father-loss development comparison
inner-transition V4 only for matching reported phenomenology

required_passes.title: Pre-synthesis completeness gate
checks: every strong claim traceable to computed testimony
no newly noticed aspect added only after outcome reveal without post-hoc label
coverage receipt includes each subcheck, not only a pass-level label
strongest omitted/unavailable frontier technique stated when it could materially change the question

required_passes.title: Layered synthesis
checks: emit a claim ledger: each substantive claim has support references, counterevidence references, dependency group, time-sensitivity/stability class, and evidence status

depth_frontier_not_yet_default: Hellenistic Lots and time-lord techniques such as zodiacal releasing
full reception/bonification/maltreatment/overcoming doctrine beyond encoded atomic rules
primary directions and fully source-grounded annual revolutions/solar returns
fixed stars, antiscia and other specialized traditional techniques
Jyotish nakshatras, Vimshottari dasha, vargas, yogas and full graha drishti
additional house systems/traditions beyond the frozen source contracts
frontier_rule: These techniques demonstrate how much deeper astrology can go, but they are UNAVAILABLE rather than improvised until separately source-audited, implemented, frozen, and tested.

completion_levels.CURRENT_RULESET_COMPLETE: All active rulesets in the current routing index/catalog and every active deep-protocol pass/subcheck were dispositioned.
completion_levels.SOURCE_TRADITION_COMPLETE: Requires a separate source-completeness registry showing the relevant source corpora/technique families have been exhaustively audited. NOT ACHIEVED by V1.
completion_levels.FRONTIER_EXPLORATORY: One or more not-yet-frozen technique families were explored; they must be separated from the frozen core and cannot retroactively make the core complete.

current_source_completeness: CURRENT_RULESET_COMPLETE can be achieved; SOURCE_TRADITION_COMPLETE is NOT_YET_ACHIEVED.

claim_ledger_contract.rule: A claim with no supporting computed/source reference cannot appear as a chart-derived conclusion. Contradicting testimony must be linked rather than omitted.
